name: Detective Sunny and the Flower Boy's Knife
source:
The year is 19XX. The kind of 19XX that has typewriters and fog and drinking in the office. Hero is off working on a secret case, you have been given the role of substitute detective. His detective agency isn't very popular, so you spend most of your time just sitting around and chatting with Basil, your assistant. Until one day, a routine case turns out to be more serious than anyone could have imagined. With Hero nowhere to be found, it's up to you to solve it.

[from [url=https://gunflower.itch.io/detective-sunny]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
时间是19XX年。那种办公室里有打字机、雾气和喝酒的19XX。英雄正在处理一个秘密案件，你被赋予了替补侦探的角色。他的侦探社不太受欢迎，所以你大部分时间只是坐在一起和你的助手巴兹尔聊天。直到有一天，一件例行公事的案件变得比任何人想象的都要严重。由于英雄无处可寻，就需要你来解决这个问题。

[来自[url=https://gunflower.itch.io/detective-sunny]itch.io[/url]]
